questions.q: Which actor played Mogambo in the 1987 superhero comedy?
questions.why: Amrish Puri's Mogambo became his most iconic and cult role.

questions.q: Mogambo is the villain of which 1987 film?
questions.why: Mogambo is the megalomaniacal villain in Shekhar Kapur's Mr. India.

questions.q: Which line became Mogambo's famous catchphrase?
questions.why: 'Mogambo khush hua' (Mogambo is pleased) is the villain's signature line, credited to Javed Akhtar.

questions.q: Where is Mogambo's high-tech lair located?
questions.why: He rules from a secret island base with missiles and acid tanks.

questions.q: What is Mogambo's background according to the character's page?
questions.why: He is an eccentric retired general turned dictator who wants to conquer India.

questions.q: Which actor was considered for Mogambo but turned it down?
questions.why: Anupam Kher declined the part, and Amrish Puri was cast after much of the film was shot.

questions.q: Roughly how much of the film had been shot when the actor was cast as Mogambo?
questions.why: Puri joined late: more than 60 percent of the film was already in the can.

questions.q: How did Shekhar Kapur want the actor to play Mogambo?
options: Grounded and realistic, like a mobster
questions.why: Puri recalled that Kapur wanted a larger-than-life baddie that children could enjoy rather than fear.

questions.q: Which writer, in tandem with Salim, created Mogambo?
questions.why: The Salim-Javed duo wrote Mr. India and created Mogambo.

questions.q: How much was the actor reportedly paid for Mogambo, making him the era's costliest villain?
questions.why: He reportedly earned Rs 1 crore, the highest pay for a screen villain at the time.
